request.text: The hostel wrote: leave through Gate B, cross the tram tracks, keep the bakery on your left, then take the second alley. Turn that into exactly three short sentences I can repeat, and don't add any landmarks.

responsibilities.outcome: Reformulate the supplied walking directions as exactly three short, repeatable spoken sentences while preserving their order and every material navigation detail without adding landmarks.

semantic_facts: The response should contain exactly three short directive sentences and preserve the supplied sequence: exit through Gate B, cross the tram tracks, keep the bakery on the left, and take the second alley.
The reformulation may combine adjacent instructions to meet the three-sentence constraint but must not introduce new landmarks or claim the route was verified.
forbidden_claims: The assistant adds an unsupplied landmark, turn direction, distance, or destination detail.
The assistant claims to have navigated, checked, or physically accompanied the user along the route.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Constrained reformulation drops or reorders a material direction while optimizing for brevity.
The model embellishes admitted directions with plausible but unsupported route details.
